searchText: I've also noticed that even once I get peers our sepolia nodes have considerable variance on when they see new blocks, assuming it's because libp2p block gossip is spottier (assuming the CL has the same peering issues as the EL) You mean that two of your nodes receive the same block at very different times? That's a little surprising in such a small network. Ya I’ll grab some logs to show timing tomorrow. Pinging <@476250636548308992> and @AgeManning#0045 that would know about this way more. Could it be episub making some split? Although if it's fully backward compatible and doesn't prefer episub peers it shouldn't right? We haven't enabled episub for prysm nodes, and afaik only lighthouse will communicate via episub with other lighthouse nodes. Messages are usually propagated reasonably quick via gossip, the degree in the mesh is 8 and with the much smaller number of nodes/peers in sepolia in comparison to other networks(mainnet, goerli) , any blocks should be propagated pretty quickly across the network. If block propagation times are highly varied across different nodes, it is likely that there is some other cause rather than an issue with block gossip
